bonus.name: generateSiteSpec determinism across two fresh processes (planner input stage)

conclusion: Semantic render equivalence HOLDS across all experiments. For identical ObjectGraph + SiteSpec + ViewerContext + design tokens, buildSemanticRenderModel is deterministic: two fresh processes, polluted module state, prior-customer rendering, 5x repetition, 3 locales, and permuted graph array order all yield byte-identical canonical models. No reproducible nondeterminism found; the negative control (reordered spec sections) correctly produces a different model, proving the check is sensitive.
equivalence_criterion: Byte-identical canonicalizeModel output (JSON with recursively sorted object keys; arrays keep render order). Byte equality of this canonical form implies semantic equivalence: same pages, same section order, same components, same bound object ids, same headings/copy, same claims. Stronger than required; any semantic difference would fail it.

pure_render_entry_point: buildSemanticRenderModel(spec, graph, viewer, opts) in src/fyd/sitespec/render-model.ts

static_analysis.locale_coupled_call: 'all' query sort uses String.localeCompare without explicit locale; measured identical across C/en_US.UTF-8/de_DE.UTF-8 for ISO timestamps. Only theoretical coupling; recommend explicit locale or codepoint comparison for full determinism hygiene.
static_analysis.module_level_mutable_state: none found in render-model.ts, renderer.tsx, sitespec/graph.ts, field-visibility.ts, safe-link.ts, components/registry.ts (grep for module-level let/var/Map/Set literals)
static_analysis.object_key_iteration: render-model.ts sortKeys uses Object.keys(value).sort(); canonicalizeOverrides sorts decisions by (objectId, field, policy); renderer claimBadgeLabel collapses a Set to a single label or the literal 'Mixed sources', so Set iteration order cannot leak into output
static_analysis.query_ordering_contract: resolveQuery: 'owner' single id lookup; 'reference' follows spec objectIds order; 'related' sorts by id; 'all' sorts updatedAt desc with id tiebreak. No dependence on graph array insertion order (confirmed empirically by perm-objects/perm-relationships).
static_analysis.wall_clock_or_randomness_in_render_path: none found: no Date.now, Math.random, crypto.randomUUID in render-model.ts, components/renderer.tsx, sitespec/graph.ts, sitespec/field-visibility.ts, sitespec/safe-link.ts
